messages:
emily: I just merged #8421 and main CI turned red :grimacing: smoke tests failing on a PrefetchEviction test on GPU shard. Can someone grab?
ci-bot: build 12345 triggered by merge 76f2e3 (automerge). failing step: smoke/gpu/serve-smoke. logs: https://ci.internal/12345 :rotating_light:
jamal: On it — pulling logs now. Which GPU shard?
emily: smoke-gpu-01 and smoke-gpu-03 both show the same test failing: TestPrefetchEviction. snippet below:
```
E   RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory when prefetching tensor (size 512MB)
  File "/workspace/runtime/prefetch.py", line 212, in prefetch_batch
    buf = device_alloc(sz)
```
seems odd given our reported free memory was ~6GB earlier.
alex: thx. does the failing agent show any spike in batch size or unexpected pinned memory?
emily: my PR adjusted prefetch heuristics to be more aggressive for long contexts — changed prefetch batch multiplier from 1.0 -> 1.6.
priya: I'll kick a rerun for the same commit (no new merge) to check flakiness. rerun: https://ci.internal/12346
oncall-bot: @jamal has been assigned as first responder for CI incidents.
jamal: rerun 12346 started. if rerun passes on cpu but fails on gpu, that suggests deterministic hardware path.
jamal: rerun results: cpu shard passed, gpu shards still fail with same OOM. batchsize inside test is 8. lowering to 4 locally reproduces pass on gpu.
alex: that lines up with the change. can you bisect between commit before PR and after? maybe the multiplier change is the culprit.
jamal: starting a quick bisect across the last 6 merges (binary search). will post progress.
emily: I can revert the multiplier change in a patch if we confirm. if bisect shows it's this PR, propose hotfix revert to unblock main.
sara: I'm catching up — tagging in since I authored the prefetch module originally. quick thought: multiplier interacts with our KV cache residency; aggressive prefetch can evict KV cache causing extra allocations. check kv cache eviction logs.
jamal: good call — seeing "kv_cache:evict shard=3 size=1.2GB" around the same time as prefetch allocation. attaching timeline.
priya: filing a short incident ticket INC-324 and adding the bisect output. will link once bisect done.
emily: thanks everyone. if bisect pins to my PR I will open a revert PR immediately.
jamal: bisect update: commit 76f2e3..76f2e3 (single-commit) is the first bad commit — confirmed change in multiplier.
alex: ok revert makes sense. emily — please open revert and mark it as hotpatch. I'll help land.
emily: opening revert now: https://git.internal/r/8462 — requesting speedy review.
jamal: after revert lands, I'll queue a rebuild on the blocked merge queue and monitor.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-324 created and linked to this thread. assignees: jamal, emily.
priya: :thumbsup: keep updates here, we'll notify product if rollback affects perf targets.
emily: landed revert, build 12389 queued. thanks all for quick eyeballs.
jamal: build 12389 passed on all smoke shards — main green again. closing triage, postmortem optional depending on perf regression telemetry. :tada:
